svg.text: "The Last Lighthouse" tells the story of an old keeper who refuses to leave his island
when the government decides to automate the lights. The first half of the film is
slow, and some viewers may lose patience, but the stunning photography of the stormy
sea more than makes up for it.
The acting is superb: Michael Hale, who plays the keeper, says very little, yet every
look on his face tells us what he feels. The young actress who plays his granddaughter
is a real discovery, although her part is too small.
The only real weakness is the ending, which feels rushed and unconvincing. Still, I
would recommend this film to anyone who loves quiet, thoughtful stories. Bring
